[[File:Fusioncutter-NEGWT.png|thumb|right|250px|SoroSuub F-187 fusioncutter]]
The '''fusioncutter''', sometimes spelled '''fusion cutter''' or '''fusion-cutter''',<ref name="ANH novel">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars: A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref> was a handheld industrial cutting and welding torch found throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Some of the more popular models were the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]] [[F-187 fusioncutter|F-187]] and the [[Jeron/Legends|Jeron]] [[Jeron fusion cutter|fusion cutter]].

The common fusioncutter consisted of a handgrip and a long emitter, producing a high-energy [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] beam. This beam could slice through dense metals, [[Duraplast/Legends|duraplast]], and other reinforced materials. The cutting beam was often adjustable, allowing the user to decrease the beam for fine, precise work, or to generate a wide-dispersion [[Laser/Legends|laser]]. Some fusioncutters could also unscrew bolts.<ref name="Star Wars Science Adventures: Journey Across Planet X">''[[Star Wars Science Adventures: Journey Across Planet X]]''</ref>

A fusioncutter's beam could be dangerous if not used correctly, though its limited range ensured the tool could not be effectively used as a weapon. However, fusioncutters were often carried into battle, notably by engineers and pilots during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the subsequent [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. These specialized engineers and pilots used fusioncutters to repair vehicles, turrets, [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]] and [[Power droid/Legends|supply droids]] on the battlefront.

Some [[power harpoon launcher]]s had a fusioncutter attached that could be used to sever the [[high-tension cable]]. Once the cable was loose, a second [[fusion disk]] could be connected to the end.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

[[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] had a fusioncutter and used it on several occasions.
